Instrument (EN): UTAUT2-Screener — original 11-item brief digital health/wellbeing technology adoption questionnaire
Scales / measured domains (EN): Seven single-item determinant scores: Performance Expectancy; Effort Expectancy; Social Influence; Facilitating Conditions; Hedonic Motivation; Price Value; Habit. Separate behavioral intention, age/gender/experience moderators; optional predictor sum 7–49, not 11-item total.
Research provenance: De Witte NAJ, Buelens F, Grassini S, Van Daele T. Journal of Technology in Behavioral Science published 2026-08-05, DOI 10.1007/s41347-026-00683-7. Original EN-GB UTAUT2-based 11-item screener pilot with UK English-fluent adults N184 (200 recruited; 16 lost follow-up), 2-week repeat; mean Spearman rho .63 with 26-item UTAUT2; retest rho .45–.64. Seven constructs each 1 item, reduced psychometric precision; age/gender/experience not psychometric subscales.
DB locales: Read-only 2026-10-28 149 published assessment keys, 234 versions (EN154 RU80 ES0); absent, distinct from existing UTAUT-P/T telepsychotherapy adaptations in Master.
